checks.observation: Visible TeX commands and dollar delimiters preserve formulas without visible clipping. They do not provide typeset operators or semantic accessibility. findings.statement: The receipt says semantic MathML is preserved, although the supplied HTML contains zero math elements and retains escaped TeX.

required_revisions: Correct the receipt's math_layout_verification wording to describe escaped source mathematics and actual visual coverage, without claiming generated semantic MathML.
